{{Top|leg}}
A '''Habitation dome''' was an artificial ecosystem created for occupation in a less than satisfactory environment for sustaining life. Manufactured with its own [[Life support/Legends|life support]] capabilities, these closed ecological systems were not dependent on matter exchange with any part outside the system. [[Varristad]] was a mining planet owned by [[Offworld Mining Corporation|Offworld Mining Corporartion]], which utilized large habitation domes as homes for the inhabitants due to Varristad's lack of [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].
